dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: All six reasoning spans achieved verified schema validation success across both rule context loading and iterative pattern generation steps. Strict adherence to prompt schemas and semantic contract v1.0 was maintained across all invocations without failure.

dimensions.name: Causal Reasoning Depth
dimensions.rationale: The pipeline established a strong causal dependency by first grounding governance rules and then systematically deriving five separate pattern artifacts from the approved ADR context, sustaining consistent reasoning across deep context windows exceeding 98k tokens per step.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis
dimensions.rationale: Iterative ADR-to-pattern evaluations demonstrated robust synthesis of competing architectural constraints into conformant pattern representations, handling trade-offs across distinct pattern facets effectively.
